build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with transition and potential graphs using gtn
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a specified number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss for a sequence pair using forward score and partition function
